from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Transformation View", [
            "Linear transformations stretch and rotate the space.",
            "A vector 'v' maps to a new vector 'Av'.",
            "Typically, 'v' changes its direction after transformation."
        ])
        
        # Setup grid and vector
        grid = NumberPlane(x_range=[-3, 3], y_range=[-3, 3], background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.5}).scale(0.5)
        self.place_in_area(grid, "B1", "E6", scale_factor=0.6)
        
        v_start = np.array([1, 1])
        v_obj = Arrow(ORIGIN, v_start, color="#FF00FF")
        v_label = Text("v", color="#FF00FF", font_size=20).next_to(v_obj.get_end(), UP, buff=0.1)
        v_group = VGroup(v_obj, v_label)
        
        # Adjust position of the vector to be relative to the grid
        v_group.move_to(grid.c2p(0.5, 0.5))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(Create(grid), run_time=1)
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFFFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(Create(v_group), run_time=1)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF")
        
        # Transformation
        matrix_a = [[1.5, 0.5], [0.5, 1.5]]
        
        # Apply matrix to vector
        v_end = np.dot(matrix_a, v_start)
        v_av = Arrow(ORIGIN, v_end, color="#00FFFF")
        v_av_label = Text("Av", color="#00FFFF", font_size=20).next_to(v_av.get_end(), UP, buff=0.1)
        v_av_group = VGroup(v_av, v_av_label)
        v_av_group.move_to(grid.c2p(v_end[0]/2, v_end[1]/2)) # Map v_end to the grid context
        
        self.play(
            grid.animate.apply_matrix(matrix_a),
            ReplacementTransform(v_group, v_av_group),
            run_time=2
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF0000")
        self.play(
            v_av_group.animate.set_color("#FF0000"),
            v_av_label.animate.set_color("#FF0000"),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(1)
